theme.title: Rotation: Value/Defensives → Growth
theme.summary: Technology (+0.31%) and Energy (+0.02%) led the market today, while Consumer Staples (-1.65%) and Health Care (-1.51%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging -0.14% versus -1.33% for defensives and -0.93% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. That shows up at the index level too: the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained +0.24% while the blue-chip Dow lagged at -0.86%. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -0.39%. The VIX rose 1.93% to 16.34, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.58% to $4,181.10, crude oil was little changed at $90.21, and bitcoin slipped 0.39% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
